title.kn: ಬಯೋ–ಸಾವರ್ಟ್ ನಿಯಮ ಮತ್ತು ವೃತ್ತಾಕಾರ ಪ್ರವಾಹ ಕುಣಿಕೆ

heading.en: Building B from tiny pieces of current

hook.en: Coulomb's law gives the field of a point charge. The Biot–*Savart* law gives the magnetic field of a tiny piece of current. Add up the pieces, and you get the field of any wire.
hook.kn: ಕೂಲುಂಬ್ ನಿಯಮ ಬಿಂದು ಆವೇಶದ ಕ್ಷೇತ್ರ ನೀಡುತ್ತದೆ. ಬಯೋ–ಸಾವರ್ಟ್ ನಿಯಮ ಸಣ್ಣ ಪ್ರವಾಹ ಅಂಶದ ಕಾಂತಕ್ಷೇತ್ರ ನೀಡುತ್ತದೆ. ಎಲ್ಲಾ ಅಂಶಗಳನ್ನು ಕೂಡಿಸಿದರೆ ಯಾವುದೇ ತಂತಿಯ ಕ್ಷೇತ್ರ ಸಿಗುತ್ತದೆ.

title.en: Find B on the axis and at the centre of a circular loop.

say.en: Coulomb's law gives the field of a point charge. The Biot-Savart law gives the magnetic field of a tiny piece of current. Add up the pieces, and you get the field of any wire. In this lesson: State the Biot-Savart law.
Find B on the axis and at the centre of a circular loop.

body.en: A *current* element I dl produces at distance r the field $dB = \frac{\mu_0}{4\pi}\frac{I\,dl\sin\theta}{r^2}$, directed along dl × r (right-hand screw rule). μ₀ = 4π × 10⁻⁷ T m A⁻¹. Like Coulomb's law it is inverse-square, but B is perpendicular to both dl and r, and it is zero along the line of the element (θ = 0).
body.kn: ಬಯೋ–ಸಾವರ್ಟ್ ನಿಯಮ: dB = (μ₀/4π) I dl sinθ/r². ಕ್ಷೇತ್ರ dl ಮತ್ತು r ಎರಡಕ್ಕೂ ಲಂಬ; ಅಂಶದ ರೇಖೆಯ ಮೇಲೆ ಶೂನ್ಯ. μ₀ = 4π × 10⁻⁷ T m A⁻¹.

points.en: Zero along the axis of the element

narration.en: The Biot–Savart law gives the field of a small current element: mu nought by 4 pi, times I dl sin theta by r squared. The field is perpendicular to both the element and the line to the point, and zero along the element's own line.
narration.kn: ಬಯೋ–ಸಾವರ್ಟ್ ನಿಯಮ: dB = (μ₀/4π) I dl sinθ/r². ಕ್ಷೇತ್ರ dl ಮತ್ತು r ಎರಡಕ್ಕೂ ಲಂಬ; ಅಂಶದ ರೇಖೆಯ ಮೇಲೆ ಶೂನ್ಯ. μ₀ = 4π × 10⁻⁷ T m A⁻¹.

say.en: The Biot-Savart law gives the field of a small current element: mu nought by 4 pi, times I dl sin theta by r squared. The field is perpendicular to both the element and the line to the point, and zero along the element's own line. dB is proportional to I dl sin theta /r squared.
say.kn: ಬಯೋ-ಸಾವರ್ಟ್ ನಿಯಮ: dB equals (micro 0 over 4 pi) I dl sin theta /r squared. ಕ್ಷೇತ್ರ dl ಮತ್ತು r ಎರಡಕ್ಕೂ ಲಂಬ; ಅಂಶದ ರೇಖೆಯ ಮೇಲೆ ಶೂನ್ಯ. micro 0 equals 4 pi times 10 to the power minus 7 T m A to the power minus 1.

say.en: Direction: dl times r.
micro 0 equals 4 pi times 10 to the power minus 7 T m A to the power minus 1.
Zero along the axis of the element.

title.en: On the board: Biot–Savart law and the circular loop

narration.en: Biot–Savart law: a small element dl carrying current I makes a field dB at P, proportional to I dl sin θ over r squared. For a circular loop of radius R, the parts along the axis add up: B = μ₀IR² / 2(x² + R²)^{3/2}. At the centre x = 0, so B = μ₀I/2R; with N turns it is N times larger. Along the axis the field is strongest at the centre and dies away on both sides. Example: 100 turns of radius 10 cm carrying 1 A give B = μ₀NI/2R ≈ 6.28 × 10⁻⁴ T at the centre.

say.en: Biot–Savart law: a small element dl carrying current I makes a field dB at P, proportional to I dl sin θ over r squared.
For a circular loop of radius R, the parts along the axis add up: B = μ₀IR² / 2(x² + R²)^{3/2}.
At the centre x = 0, so B = μ₀I/2R; with N turns it is N times larger.
Along the axis the field is strongest at the centre and dies away on both sides.
Example: 100 turns of radius 10 cm carrying 1 A give B = μ₀NI/2R ≈ 6.28 × 10⁻⁴ T at the centre.

Biot-Savart law: a small element dl carrying current I makes a field dB at P, proportional to I dl sin theta over r squared. For a circular loop of radius R, the parts along the axis add up: B equals micro 0IR squared divided by 2x squared plus R squared^{3 over 2}. At the centre x equals 0, so B equals micro 0I/2R; with N turns it is N times larger. Along the axis the field is strongest at the centre and dies away on both sides. Example: 100 turns of radius 10 centimetres carrying 1 A give B equals micro 0NI/2R is approximately 6.28 times 10 to the power minus 4 T at the centre.

title.en: Magnetic field on the axis of a current loop
title.kn: ವಿದ್ಯುತ್ ಕುಣಿಕೆಯ ಅಕ್ಷದ ಮೇಲೆ ಕಾಂತ ಕ್ಷೇತ್ರ

narration.en: Each bit of the loop adds a field by the Biot–Savart law. On the axis the sideways parts cancel and B = μ0 N I R² / 2(R² + x²)^(3/2), largest at the centre, μ0NI/2R, and fading fast with distance. Drag the probe along the axis. The loop is seen edge-on.

caption.en: Each bit of the loop adds a field by the Biot–Savart law. On the axis the sideways parts cancel and B = μ0 N I R² / 2(R² + x²)^(3/2), largest at the centre, μ0NI/2R, and fading fast with distance. Drag the probe along the axis. The loop is seen edge-on.
caption.kn: ಕುಣಿಕೆಯ ಪ್ರತಿ ಭಾಗವೂ ಬಯೋ–ಸಾವರ್ಟ್ ನಿಯಮದಂತೆ ಕ್ಷೇತ್ರ ಸೇರಿಸುತ್ತದೆ. ಅಕ್ಷದ ಮೇಲೆ ಪಕ್ಕದ ಭಾಗಗಳು ರದ್ದಾಗಿ B = μ0 N I R² / 2(R² + x²)^(3/2); ಕೇಂದ್ರದಲ್ಲಿ ಗರಿಷ್ಠ μ0NI/2R, ದೂರದಲ್ಲಿ ವೇಗವಾಗಿ ಕುಗ್ಗುತ್ತದೆ. ಶೋಧಕವನ್ನು ಅಕ್ಷದಲ್ಲಿ ಎಳೆಯಿರಿ.

say.en: Each bit of the loop adds a field by the Biot-Savart law. On the axis the sideways parts cancel and B equals micro 0 N I R squared divided by 2R squared plus x squared^(3 over 2), largest at the centre, micro 0NI/2R, and fading fast with distance. Drag the probe along the axis. The loop is seen edge-on.

title.en: Field on the axis of a circular loop

body.en: For a loop of radius R carrying *current* I, at distance x along its axis: $B = \mu_0IR^2/2(x^2 + R^2)^{3/2}$, directed along the axis. At the centre (x = 0) this is $\mu_0I/2R$; with N turns multiply by N. Right-hand thumb rule: curl the fingers along the current, the thumb gives B.
body.kn: ವೃತ್ತಾಕಾರ ಕುಣಿಕೆಯ ಅಕ್ಷದ ಮೇಲೆ B = μ₀IR²/2(x² + R²)^{3/2}. ಕೇಂದ್ರದಲ್ಲಿ B = μ₀NI/2R. ದಿಕ್ಕು ಬಲಗೈ ಹೆಬ್ಬೆರಳು ನಿಯಮದಿಂದ.

narration.en: On the axis of a loop the field is mu nought I R squared over 2 times x squared plus R squared to the power three by two. At the centre it is mu nought N I by 2R.
narration.kn: ವೃತ್ತಾಕಾರ ಕುಣಿಕೆಯ ಅಕ್ಷದ ಮೇಲೆ B = μ₀IR²/2(x² + R²)^{3/2}. ಕೇಂದ್ರದಲ್ಲಿ B = μ₀NI/2R. ದಿಕ್ಕು ಬಲಗೈ ಹೆಬ್ಬೆರಳು ನಿಯಮದಿಂದ.

blocks.formula: B = \frac{\mu_0 I R^2}{2\,(x^2 + R^2)^{3/2}},\qquad B_{centre} = \frac{\mu_0 N I}{2R}

say.en: On the axis of a loop the field is mu nought I R squared over 2 times x squared plus R squared to the power three by two. At the centre it is mu nought N I by 2R. Axis: B equals micro 0IR squared/2x squared plus R squared^{3 over 2}.
say.kn: ವೃತ್ತಾಕಾರ ಕುಣಿಕೆಯ ಅಕ್ಷದ ಮೇಲೆ B equals micro 0IR squared/2x squared plus R squared^{3 over 2}. ಕೇಂದ್ರದಲ್ಲಿ B equals micro 0NI/2R. ದಿಕ್ಕು ಬಲಗೈ ಹೆಬ್ಬೆರಳು ನಿಯಮದಿಂದ.

say.en: Centre: B equals micro 0NI/2R.
Right-hand thumb rule.

title.en: Field on the axis of a circular coil

caption.en: B on the axis of a coil of N turns and radius R carrying I, against the distance x from the centre (x and R in cm, B in μT).

tryThis.en: Set N = 100, I = 1 A, R = 10 cm: B at the centre is 628 μT = 6.28 × 10⁻⁴ T.
Double R: the centre field halves, but the curve spreads out.
At x = R the field is about 35 % of the centre value, whatever R is.

narration.en: B on the axis of a coil of N turns and radius R carrying I, against the distance x from the centre (x and R in cm, B in μT). Set N = 100, I = 1 A, R = 10 cm: B at the centre is 628 μT = 6.28 × 10⁻⁴ T. Double R: the centre field halves, but the curve spreads out. At x = R the field is about 35 % of the centre value, whatever R is.

say.en: B on the axis of a coil of N turns and radius R carrying I, against the distance x from the centre (x and R in cm, B in micro T). Set N equals 100, I equals 1 A, R equals 10 centimetres: B at the centre is 628 micro T equals 6.28 times 10 to the power minus 4 T. Double R: the centre field halves, but the curve spreads out. At x equals R the field is about 35 percent of the centre value, whatever R is.

problem.en: A tightly wound coil of 100 turns and radius 10 cm carries 1 A. Find the field at its centre.

narration.en: Let us solve this together. A tightly wound coil of 100 turns and radius 10 cm carries 1 A. Find the field at its centre.

say.en: Let us solve this together. A tightly wound coil of 100 turns and radius 10 centimetres carries 1 A. Find the field at its centre.
B equals micro 0NI/2R.
B equals 4 pi times 10 to the power minus 7 times 100 times 1 over 2 times 0.1.
B equals 1.257 times 10 to the power minus 4 over 0.2 is approximately 6.28 times 10 to the power minus 4 T.
So the answer is About 6.28 times 10 to the power minus 4 T.

problem.en: Compare the field on the axis of a loop at x = R with the field at its centre.

narration.en: Let us solve this together. Compare the field on the axis of a loop at x = R with the field at its centre.

say.en: Let us solve this together. Compare the field on the axis of a loop at x equals R with the field at its centre.
B axis/B centre equals R cubed/x squared plus R squared^{3 over 2}.
At x equals R: R cubed/2R squared^{3 over 2} = 1 over 2^{3 over 2}.
= 1 over 2 the square root of 2 is approximately 0.35.
So the answer is B axis equals B centre/2 the square root of 2.

heading.en: Field at the centre of an arc

body.en: An arc subtending angle θ (radians) at its centre gives B = (μ₀I/4πR) × θ there. Full circle (θ = 2π): μ₀I/2R. Semicircle (θ = π): μ₀I/4R. Quarter circle: μ₀I/8R.

narration.en: Field at the centre of an arc. An arc subtending angle θ (radians) at its centre gives B = (μ₀I/4πR) × θ there. Full circle (θ = 2π): μ₀I/2R. Semicircle (θ = π): μ₀I/4R. Quarter circle: μ₀I/8R.

say.en: Field at the centre of an arc. An arc subtending angle theta radians at its centre gives B equals (micro 0I/4 pi R) times theta there. Full circle theta equals 2 pi: micro 0I/2R. Semicircle theta equals pi: micro 0I/4R. Quarter circle: micro 0I/8R.
